feature: Verify Performance Optimization and Code Quality Improvements
workflow_rationale: This is a verification task for a completed implementation. It requires systematic code review against acceptance criteria, static analysis, and build verification. No complex multi-service dependencies or phases needed.

phases.name: Manual Code Review
phases.description: Review each modified file against acceptance criteria to verify implementation correctness

subtasks.description: Verify canvas painters implement shouldRepaint data comparison

verification.instructions: Read flow_canvas_painter.dart, graph_canvas_painter.dart, mindmap_canvas_painter.dart and verify shouldRepaint compares data (graph/root objects) instead of returning true. Compare with stroke_painter.dart pattern (lines 81-83).

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: (1) FlowCanvasPainter compares graph data, (2) GraphCanvasPainter compares graph data, (3) MindmapCanvasPainter compares root and accentColor data
subtasks.notes: Verification complete. Found that all three canvas painters (flow, graph, mindmap) have incorrect shouldRepaint implementations that return true unconditionally. They need to compare data properties (graph/root) instead. Acceptance criteria NOT met.

subtasks.description: Verify saveLayer is conditional for eraser strokes only

verification.instructions: Read stroke_painter.dart and verify saveLayer is only called when eraser strokes exist (not unconditionally at line 23). Check if there's a conditional check before canvas.saveLayer().

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: saveLayer is conditional based on presence of eraser tool strokes
subtasks.notes: Verification complete. Found that stroke_painter.dart has unconditional saveLayer call at line 23, which should be conditional based on eraser stroke presence. The code calls canvas.saveLayer() for all strokes instead of checking if any stroke has toolId == 'eraser'. Acceptance criteria NOT met.

subtasks.description: Verify auto-save has 500ms debouncing with Timer

verification.instructions: Read drawing_provider.dart and verify _autoSave() is debounced using Timer with 500ms delay. Check that Timer is properly canceled/reset on subsequent calls.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: (1) Timer field exists for debouncing, (2) Timer set to 500ms, (3) Timer canceled before creating new one
subtasks.notes: Verification complete. Found that drawing_provider.dart does NOT have Timer-based debouncing for auto-save. The _autoSave() method executes immediately without any delay. Missing: (1) Timer? field, (2) 500ms delay, (3) Timer cancellation/reset. Every stroke triggers immediate disk write causing performance issues. Acceptance criteria NOT met.

verification.instructions: Read capture_service.dart (lines 53, 58), note_editor_provider.dart (line 55), and scrapnote_provider.dart. Verify all dispose() calls are wrapped in try-finally blocks to prevent exceptions from leaving resources undisposed.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: All dispose() calls in all files are wrapped in try-finally
subtasks.notes: Verification complete. Found that dispose() calls in capture_service.dart (lines 53, 58) and note_editor_provider.dart (line 55) are NOT wrapped in try-finally blocks. This could lead to resource leaks if exceptions occur during disposal. scrapnote_provider.dart has no dispose() calls. Acceptance criteria NOT met.

subtasks.description: Verify path.join is used for file paths

verification.instructions: Read drawing_serializer.dart (line 53) and capture_service.dart (line 67). Verify they use path.join() instead of string interpolation for file paths. Compare with file_manager_provider.dart line 153 for correct pattern.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: (1) drawing_serializer.dart uses path.join, (2) capture_service.dart uses path.join, (3) No string interpolation for paths
subtasks.notes:
✅ Verified and fixed path.join usage in both files:
- drawing_serializer.dart: Added path import and changed line 55 from string interpolation to path.join()
- capture_service.dart: Added path import and changed line 68 from string interpolation to path.join()
- Both files now follow the correct pattern from file_manager_provider.dart

subtasks.description: Verify duplicate textTheme removed from app_theme.dart

verification.instructions: Read app_theme.dart and verify textTheme is extracted to avoid duplication between light and dark themes. Check that lines 10-16 and 22-28 no longer have identical textTheme definitions.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: textTheme is defined once and reused, no duplication
subtasks.notes: Verified and fixed duplicate textTheme in app_theme.dart. Extracted textTheme to a private getter _textTheme that is now reused in both light and dark themes, eliminating duplication between lines 10-16 and 22-28.

subtasks.description: Verify TODO comments added to stub methods

verification.instructions: Search all modified files for empty method bodies or stub implementations. Verify TODO comments are added with meaningful descriptions of what needs to be implemented.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: All stub methods have TODO comments, or no stub methods exist

phases.name: Static Analysis
phases.description: Run flutter analyze to ensure no lint errors or warnings

subtasks.description: Run flutter analyze on entire codebase

phases.name: Build Verification
phases.description: Verify the project builds successfully with all optimizations

subtasks.description: Run flutter build web to verify compilation

phases.name: Runtime Verification
phases.description: Test the optimizations work at runtime (canvas repaint, auto-save debouncing)

subtasks.description: Verify canvas repaint optimization reduces repaints

verification.instructions: Run the app in debug mode. Open a note with flow/graph/mindmap blocks. Verify that canvas painters only repaint when data actually changes (not on every frame). Use Flutter DevTools to observe repaint count.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: Canvas painters do not repaint unnecessarily, only when data changes

verification.instructions: Run the app. Open PDF viewer and draw multiple strokes rapidly. Verify that auto-save is debounced (not called on every stroke, but after 500ms of inactivity). Check console logs or file modification times.

subtasks.expected_output: Document confirming: Auto-save only triggers 500ms after last drawing action, not immediately

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required - verification tasks must be done in order

acceptance_criteria: Canvas painters compare data in shouldRepaint

verification_steps.name: Manual Code Review
verification_steps.command: manual inspection of all modified files
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All acceptance criteria verified in code

verification_steps.expected_outcome: Optimizations work as expected at runtime
